name: Use Czech voice, web search and AI image studio on mobile
covers: Czech speech input and spoken responses
foreground wake phrase and background limitation
client-side image resize and compression before upload
description: Verifies the main AI workflows work on a phone and unavailable browser or AI capabilities are reported honestly.
steps: Sign in to Micro Helper
Open the voice panel and verify Czech speech controls and the foreground-only wake-phrase limitation
Search for a public topic and verify a summary and source links appear
Generate an image from a short prompt, verify the preview and download action, then select a reference image and verify a resized preview is shown
Upload a reference image, run analysis and extract readable text
expected: Voice controls report actual browser support and foreground-only limits; web search shows a summary and source links; image generation, analysis and OCR return visible results or a clear retryable error.

name: Synchronize plans, notes and preferences across devices
description: Verifies learning plan changes propagate live between two clients belonging to the same account.
steps: Sign in as Actor A on the mobile client
Sign in as Actor B in a second client using the same account
Create a plan named Live sync check as Actor A
Verify the plan appears for Actor B without refreshing the second client
Change the plan objective as Actor B and verify the updated objective appears for Actor A
Create a private note and a preference as Actor A
Verify both appear for Actor B without refreshing the second client
Edit the note and update the preference as Actor B
Verify the changed note and preference appear for Actor A
Delete the note and preference as Actor B
Verify both deleted items disappear for Actor A and a signed-out client cannot access account data
expected: Both clients show the latest plan, note and preference data without manual refresh; note and preference deletion is reflected across devices, and a signed-out client cannot access account data.

name: Pair Windows Companion and reject unauthorized desktop commands
description: Verifies the Windows bridge requires local pairing and only exposes a small allowlist of safe desktop actions.
steps: Open the Windows Companion panel without a local companion running
Attempt pairing with an invalid code and verify a visible failure
Verify desktop command buttons remain disabled until pairing succeeds
Review companion instructions and confirm supported actions are lock, Explorer, Notepad and Calculator
expected: Invalid pairing is rejected, commands remain disabled without a valid local session, and arbitrary shell execution is not exposed.

name: Keep offline mode honest and install the Android app
description: Verifies local data remains usable offline, cloud features are not faked, and the Android install path is available.
steps: Remain signed out and verify cloud-only actions explain that sign-in is required
Create a local note and reload the page to verify local persistence
After the first online visit, reload with the network disabled and verify the app shell plus JavaScript and CSS still load while cloud actions clearly report that they need a connection
Open the browser install option when supported or use Chrome's Install app menu
Open the GitHub Android build workflow and verify a successful run produces an installable debug APK artifact
expected: Local data persists, cloud AI and remote commands are not fabricated offline, PWA installation is available where supported, and the Android workflow builds an APK artifact.

name: Create and execute an AI task
covers: quick and deep chat response setting
description: Verifies a saved task can be run by the cloud AI and its completed result remains visible after refreshing the task list.
steps: Sign in to Micro Helper
Create a task with a short title and a concrete text instruction
Select Run AI for the new task
Verify the task changes to completed and a useful result appears
Refresh the page and verify the completed result remains available
Switch the chat response depth between quick and deep and save the setting
expected: The authenticated task endpoint produces and persists a Czech result; failures are shown as retryable errors, and chat sends the selected response depth.
